{"search_note":"I did **not** find reliable 2024 Biden-specific evidence on:
- AI safety or frontier-model governance,
- cyber incident handling,
- biological-risk oversight,
- or explicit transparency frameworks for dual-use emerging technology outside the nuclear/WMD area.

The negative side is therefore mostly a **coverage gap**, not strong counterevidence.","evidence":[{"title":"NNSA completes subcritical experiment at PULSE facility in Nevada","publisher":"U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/articles/nnsa-completes-subcritical-experiment-pulse-facility-nevada","summary":"NNSA said the subcritical experiment provided essential data for the safety, security, reliability, and effectiveness of nuclear warheads **without nuclear explosive testing**. This is strong precautionary handling of a catastrophic-risk domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3"]},{"title":"NNSA calls attention to the security of nuclear materials in transit at International Conference on Nuclear Security","publisher":"U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration","date":"2024-05-31","url":"https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/articles/nnsa-calls-attention-security-nuclear-materials-transit-international-conference","summary":"The U.S. and UK co-sponsored an IAEA event encouraging stronger security for nuclear materials in transit, including stronger regulatory frameworks and planning for emerging threats. That is evidence of precaution and institutional transparency around dual-use material movement.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.4"]},{"title":"Statement by the United States on the Twentieth Anniversary of UNSCR 1540","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024-04-29","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/statement-by-the-united-states-on-the-twentieth-anniversary-of-unscr-1540/","summary":"The United States called UNSCR 1540 one of the most important tools against proliferation and urged states to keep sensitive WMD-related goods and know-how under regulatory control. This is direct evidence of precaution in a dual-use/WMD category.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.4","1B.6"]},{"title":"Secretary Blinken’s Meeting with IAEA Director General Grossi","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024-03-15","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/secretary-blinken-s-meeting-with-iaea-director-general-grossi-2/","summary":"Blinken reaffirmed U.S. support for the IAEA verification mission and discussed safeguards issues, including Zaporizhzhia and Iran. This supports a reading of Biden-era policy as precautionary and inspection-friendly rather than opaque.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.4","1B.6"]},{"title":"DOD Sends Report to Congress on the Nuclear Weapons Employment Strategy of the United States","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"2024-11-15","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3966543/dod-sends-report-to-congress-on-the-nuclear-weapons-employment-strategy-of-the/","summary":"The updated nuclear guidance stresses escalation management, integration of non-nuclear capabilities, and deeper allied consultation. That is evidence of structured risk control in a catastrophic-risk domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.8","1B.1"]},{"title":"Biden quietly shipped long-range ATACMS to Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/the-us-quietly-shipped-longrange-atacms-missiles-to-ukraine-3394976","summary":"The administration secretly transferred long-range missiles to Ukraine. This is **weak counterevidence** for transparency, because it shows secrecy in a major security decision, but it is not direct evidence of mishandling AI, cyber, or biological risk.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"Biden allows Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied weapons in strikes near Kharkiv","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-allows-ukraine-to-use-ussupplied-arms-to-strike-inside-russia-near-kharkiv-area-say-us-officials-3464558","summary":"Biden loosened restrictions so Ukraine could strike military targets inside Russia near Kharkiv. This is escalation-adjacent and somewhat opaque, but it is still primarily a conventional-war decision rather than a clear catastrophic-risk-domain failure.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.8","1B.5"]}]}
